correctness.rationale: For surjective alternating β:Λ² F_q⁴→F_q², every nonzero dual alternating 4-form has rank 2 or 4, detected by binary quadratic Pfaffian Q. Character orthogonality gives F(c)=q^(-2)[q⁸+q⁴Σ_{λ≠0}ψ(−λc)+(q⁶−q⁴)Σ_{Qλ=0,λ≠0}ψ(−λc)]. Summing projective root lines gives the stated separate N(0) and N(c≠0) formulas with root count r and annihilator indicator s(c); central factors contribute q⁴. Characteristic two, Q identically zero, and q=2 follow identically. Summing fibers returns q^12. Independent exhaustive pair enumeration over q=2,3,5 for split and identically-zero pencil families agreed target by target.

originality.rationale: Six-dimensional nilpotent-algebra classification already lists 2-planes of alternating 4-forms and their Pfaffian strata, not the explicit prescribed commutator counts. Levy 2016 Theorem 2.1 provides a powerful **broader rank-stratum/hyperplane formula for commutator word maps of odd-p exponent-p groups**, and its odd-characteristic specialization essentially produces this distribution. That general machinery is prior mathematics and substantially reduces the novelty scope. However Levy excludes p=2 (class 2 is not <p), and does not tabulate this full all-characteristic 4-to-2 Pfaffian-root target census; the submitted direct additive-character proof covers characteristic 2 and degenerate Q, including central extensions not requiring full center=derived. Qualified novelty survives only for explicit uniform all-field target stratification and the characteristic-two boundary, not general Fourier or odd-p orbit-method methods.
residual_risks: Levy 2016 makes the odd-p part essentially a corollary of existing general rank-hyperplane machinery; do not claim originality for that general reduction.
A characteristic-two general additive bilinear-map theorem might also imply the explicit root-line counts; priority not exhaustively certified.
Theorems are Lie-algebra brackets in every characteristic; nonabelian exponent-two class-two group analog is unavailable.
